# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an ugly man with tow-colored hair. His radiant happiness makes him appear pleasant rather than plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P13](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0013), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He is friendly, cheerful, and loves to joke and laugh. Decisive in his thinking, he offers sound and practical guidance when others are perplexed. He possesses a strong sense of devotion, willingly serving in challenging settings with genuine happiness.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Traits

- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>
- cheerful  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- preaching and leading prayers  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- to serve in a mission church in the slums  <sub>[v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College and later St. Columbia. During a summer break, he stayed at the same boarding location as Philippa Gordon, spending time fishing, boating, and talking with her, which led to them falling in love. Despite initial doubts from Philippa's mother, he visited her family at Mount Holly and won their affection. Upon graduating from St. Columbia, he took charge of a mission church on Patterson Street in the slums. He married Philippa in June following his graduation. Later, he and Philippa attended Anne Shirley's wedding at Green Gables, where he delivered a beautiful wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
